These six columns are all required, non-null (null_rate 0.0) in the profile and together identify a specific carrier's flight number departing a specific NYC origin on a specific date, the smallest defensible grain available without relying on nullable time columns.

dep_time (null_rate 0.029388), dep_delay (0.029388), arr_time (0.0307), arr_delay (0.032981) and air_time (0.032981) share closely aligned null rates consistent with flights that never departed or arrived, per operator context; nulls are retained rather than imputed or dropped.
tailnum has null_rate 0.009154 (1521 of 166158 rows), likely unassigned or unrecorded aircraft; retained as nullable rather than failed or imputed.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta all carry is_airbyte_metadata true and are capture-tool artifacts, not business data, so all three are dropped.

year, month, day, dep_time, sched_dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, sched_arr_time, arr_delay, flight, air_time, distance, hour, and minute land as DECIMAL(38,9) but every sampled and distinct value across these columns is integral, supporting a cast to INTEGER.
time_hour has null_rate 0.0 and all sampled values follow the consistent ISO-8601 UTC pattern (e.g. 2013-01-01T10:00:00Z), supporting a cast from VARCHAR to TIMESTAMP.

purpose: This table is the cleaned NYC flights departures record for January through June 2013 from the three NYC airports (JFK, LGA, EWR), sourced from the nycflights13 bronze landing, and feeds downstream flight delay and on-time performance analysis.
usage: Consumers should treat dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, air_time, and tailnum as nullable fields where null indicates a flight that never departed or arrived (or an unrecorded tail number) rather than a data quality defect, and should not impute or drop these rows; join on carrier, flight, origin, and date fields for the declared grain.
limitations: Pipeline metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped and carry no business meaning; roughly 3% of rows have no departure or arrival time (null_rate 0.029388 to 0.032981) and these were retained as nulls rather than resolved; the dataset covers only January through June 2013, not the full year.
